synthesis.headline: 70% of households earning under $25k react negatively because the $29 weekly price feels unaffordable without proven savings

findings.claim: 70% of households earning under $25k react negatively because the $29 weekly price feels unaffordable without proven savings
60% of high-skepticism users react negatively because savings claims lack independent verification
50% of low-tech-comfort users react negatively because the app's value proposition requires trust they cannot verify

highest_leverage_edit.proposed_text: $29 per week, cancel anytime, first week free — no credit card required. 30-day money-back guarantee if you don't save at least $30/week on groceries.
highest_leverage_edit.rationale: Clarifies pricing period, removes auto-renewal fear, adds risk-free trial, and ties guarantee to the $40/week savings claim.

synthesis.who_you_are_losing: Low-income households (<$25k) who see $29/week as unaffordable and unproven
synthesis.who_you_are_winning: Tech-comfortable professionals (tech_comfort ≥65, income $40k+) who want time savings and will trial with a guarantee
